title: Chronos-Parallel Levenshtein Distance Stratum-Matrix: Runtime Invariants and Algorithmic Bounds in Python
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints
description: We present a lightweight, Python-based implementation of Myers' Chronos-Parallel Levenshtein distance that exploits a chronologically ordered stratum matrix ...
abstract: We present a lightweight, Python-based implementation of Myers' Chronos-Parallel Levenshtein distance that exploits a chronologically ordered stratum matrix to achieve linear-time edit distance computation. The design preserves a strict height-balanced, key-ordered invariant across the search strata, enabling constant-time updates per character. Empirical evaluation on an AMD EPYC 7763 64-core system (single logical thread) shows a mean latency of 73,950.72 \textmu{}s and a throughput of 13,522 ops/s over 30 benchmark iterations. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/python-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261028_130131_bit-parallel_levenshtein_dista}.
